# Subway Seat for Windows Terminal

Each flavor is a color scheme plus a theme for the tab row, tabs and window frame. The fragment adds all three schemes on its own; the themes still go into settings.json.

[Windows Terminal](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/terminal/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/windows-terminal/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | Merge into the top-level `schemes` and `themes` arrays of settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file) |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | Merge into the top-level `schemes` and `themes` arrays of settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file) |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | Merge into the top-level `schemes` and `themes` arrays of settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file) |
| All three | [`subway-seat-all.json`](subway-seat-all.json) | Merge into the top-level `schemes` and `themes` arrays of settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file) |
| All three | [`fragment/subway-seat.json`](fragment/subway-seat.json) | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows Terminal\Fragments\SubwaySeat\subway-seat.json` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file), after merging the `schemes` and `themes` entries:

```json
// at the top level
"theme": "Subway Seat",
// inside your existing "profiles": { "defaults": { … } }
"colorScheme": "Subway Seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file), after merging the `schemes` and `themes` entries:

```json
// at the top level
"theme": "Subway Seat Tunnel",
// inside your existing "profiles": { "defaults": { … } }
"colorScheme": "Subway Seat Tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in settings.json (Settings › Open JSON file), after merging the `schemes` and `themes` entries:

```json
// at the top level
"theme": "Subway Seat Enamel",
// inside your existing "profiles": { "defaults": { … } }
"colorScheme": "Subway Seat Enamel"
```

## Follow light and dark

In settings.json, with every flavor's `schemes` and `themes` merged (subway-seat-all.json):

```json
// at the top level
"theme": { "light": "Subway Seat Enamel", "dark": "Subway Seat" },
// inside your existing "profiles": { "defaults": { … } }
"colorScheme": { "light": "Subway Seat Enamel", "dark": "Subway Seat" }
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows Terminal\Fragments\SubwaySeat\subway-seat.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
